# Installed MTL test fixture

ComposerSlider.tsx and styles.ts come unchanged from the source map of the actual installed dsh-model-think-level 2.3.3. License: MIT, GaoHu1997. These are test-only and are not shipped in the plugin package.

Catalog/order/knowledge helpers are stubbed in helpers.js; selection uses the existing mock directory. Tests execute the real slider pointer/keyboard/commit/rollback handlers and real CSS without connecting to a live model backend.
